programs.name: 花びら形台座
programs.source: const pointsCount=128;const maxR=45;const minR=35;const petals=8;const h=6;let shape=[];for(let i=0;i<pointsCount;i++){const angle=i*2*Math.PI/pointsCount;const petalPhase=(angle*petals/(2*Math.PI))%1;const radius=minR+(maxR-minR)*Math.sin(petalPhase*Math.PI);const r=maxR-(maxR-minR)*Math.sin(petalPhase*Math.PI);const radiusSmooth=minR+(maxR-minR)*Math.sin(petalPhase*Math.PI*2);const radiusFinal=minR+(maxR-minR)*Math.pow(Math.sin(petalPhase*Math.PI),0.8);const radiusAdjusted=minR+(maxR-minR)*Math.sin(petalPhase*Math.PI);const radiusCalc=minR+(maxR-minR)*Math.sin(petalPhase*Math.PI);const rFinal = minR + (maxR - minR)*Math.sin(petalPhase*Math.PI);const radiusShape=minR+(maxR-minR)*Math.sin(petalPhase*Math.PI);const r2= minR + (maxR - minR)*Math.pow(Math.sin(petalPhase * Math.PI),1.2);const radiusUsed=minR+(maxR-minR)*Math.sin(petalPhase*Math.PI);const radiusValue = minR + (maxR - minR)*Math.sin(petalPhase*Math.PI);const radiusFinalUsed=minR+(maxR-minR)*Math.sin(petalPhase*Math.PI);const rUsed = minR + (maxR - minR)*Math.sin(petalPhase*Math.PI);const radiusFinalCalc=minR+(maxR-minR)*Math.sin(petalPhase*Math.PI);const rShape=minR+(maxR-minR)*Math.sin(petalPhase*Math.PI);const radiusPoint=minR+(maxR-minR)*Math.sin(petalPhase*Math.PI);const radiusFinalPoint=minR+(maxR-minR)*Math.sin(petalPhase*Math.PI);const rr=minR+(maxR-minR)*Math.sin(petalPhase*Math.PI);const radiusFinalFinal=minR+(maxR-minR)*Math.sin(petalPhase*Math.PI);const x=45+rr*Math.cos(angle);const y=45+rr*Math.sin(angle);shape.push([x,y]);}shape.push(shape[0]);return extrude(shape,h);
